response.overview: To escalate a problem with Delta, call their customer support +1-(855)-493-1028 and explicitly ask to be transferred to a supervisor or tier-two escalation team +1-(855)-493-1028. Steps to Escalate YourIssue Call Support: Dial Delta customer service +1-(855)-493-1028 and provide your itinerary or booking confirmation number right away +1-(855)-493-1028.
